scopeDefinition: Primary display universe: UCLs with 100-1,499 usual residents, excluding special/non-settlement records. This is a Tiny Towns Atlas product definition, not an ABS definition of a town. The published diabetes analysis this Atlas builds on used a lower bound of 200 residents.
